## MUS-I-0001

**A mandated tool call is honoured**

investigation · 2026-08-19

Discharges: [MUS-M-0001](milestones.md#mus-m-0001)

The smallest disproof of the delivery bet every module depends on: whether a clause in a repository-local context file is enough to make an agent call a tool it was never told about in its prompt. The protocol and the decision rule were committed before the scored runs executed. Accepted at 20 of 20 against a rule of 18 of 20.
